messages:
miguel: Heads-up — AcmeCloud marketplace listing health checks are failing (partner reported). They asked for a shared channel and a short war room to triage. Can someone create the shared channel and assign a bridge runner? :wave:
laura: copying the SI and SRE leads. I can create a shared channel (redwood-acme-marketplace) and invite Jordan when they confirm. Who should be the bridge runner?
sathya: I can take the bridge runner for the first 30m. I want SRE on standby for model-serving traces. miguel, can you paste partner logs or ticket link?
miguel: ticket: https://acme.support/INC-48291. Partner says intermittent 502s from our model endpoints when they hit the marketplace workload. They saw 5xx spikes around 12:10 UTC. sample log snippet: ```ERROR 502 gateway "kv-cache-miss" seq=1254 model=redwood-7b```
laura: noted. ops-bot, can you surface recent deploys & alert windows to the channel?
ops-bot: deploybot: New rollout to prod (model-serving cluster) at 11:58 UTC by @deploy-ci. Alerts: increased 5xx rate on marketplace-route 12:08–12:16 UTC. :bell:
miguel: partner also says their SI integrator (Nebula) did a config change reversing header forwarding. They rolled that back but errors persisted. Suggest we start with routing + gateway checks, then look at KV cache and batching config.
sathya: Agreed. Quick triage plan for the bridge: 1) confirm partner is on shared channel and bridge link 2) check routing & gateway (nginx/ingress) 3) look at model-serving logs for OOMs/latency spikes 4) snapshot prefix cache stats. If any step shows >10% failed requests for 5m escalate to SEV2.
miguel: Jordan (partner) — can you join the shared channel and paste the SI contact and sample curl we can replay? @jordan_acme
jordan_acme: joining now. curl they used: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/marketplace/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'``` They get `HTTP/1.1 502` ~ 60% of requests under their load generator.
laura: created channel #redwood-acme-marketplace and invited Jordan. I've pinned the runbook snippet and the bridge link. Bridge link: https://meet.redwood/bridge/ACME-421
sathya: I'm on the bridge. Can someone assign rotation for postmortem owner if we need one? I'd suggest @laura as comms owner and @miguel for partner liaison.
miguel: agree. laura for comms, miguel partner liaison, sathya bridge runner. If we hit SEV2, escalate to oncall-sre and engineering leads.
laura: I'll keep the partner updated on status every 10m and post RCA notes here. Jordan, please share any additional request headers or backoff settings.
jordan_acme: sharing headers and traffic profile in the shared channel. thanks for the fast response.
sathya: initial check: ingress logs show 502s all forwarded to model-serving gateway with elevated latency ~250–700ms, and a few backend 504s. KV cache hit ratio dropped by 30% during the spike. I'm running a focused replay of the partner pattern now.
miguel: if replay reproduces, we can temporarily route partner traffic to the dedicated capacity pool (redwood-dedicated-acme) as a mitigation while we investigate root cause. Jordan — would that work for you for short term?
jordan_acme: yes, we can fail over to the dedicated pool for now. Please confirm expected downtime window.
laura: mitigation plan: 1) failover partner to dedicated pool (5–10 min to switch) 2) run traffic replay against dedicated pool, confirm stability 3) collect traces + KV cache dump for postmortem. Will post timeline in the next update. :white_check_mark:
sathya: executing failover now. notifying oncall-sre.
ops-bot: action: traffic_reroute executed by sathya at 12:28 UTC — partner routed to redwood-dedicated-acme. Monitoring for 5m.
sathya: early signals look good — 502s dropped to <1% in dedicated pool. Leaving bridge open for 30m to collect traces and coordinate postmortem tasks.
miguel: thanks all. after bridge we should capture an escalation mapping doc: shared-channel membership rules, bridge-runner duties, immediate mitigation options (dedicated-pool failover), and partner contact handoff checklist. I'll draft and share in #partnerships tomorrow.
laura: thanks team — Jordan, I'll send post-failover confirmation and next steps in the shared channel. :pray:
